per_case_results.question: What is the percentage difference of student badges given during 2010 and 2011?

SELECT
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") = 2011 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") = 2010 THEN 1 END), 0)) - 100.0
FROM "badges"

LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: Calculate the ratio of votes in 2010 and 2011.

per_case_results.question: Among the posts with views ranging from 100 to 150, what is the comment with the highest score?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE PostId IN (SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE ViewCount BETWEEN 100 AND 150) ORDER BY Score DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "comments".*
FROM "comments"
JOIN "posts" ON "comments"."postid" = "posts"."id"
WHERE "posts"."viewcount" BETWEEN 100 AND 150
ORDER BY "comments"."score" DESC
LIMIT 1

per_case_results.question: In posts with 1 comment, how many of the comments have 0 score?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T2.CommentCount = 1 AND T2.Score = 0
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM "comments" c
WHERE c."score" = 0
AND c."postid" IN (
    SELECT "postid"
    FROM "comments"
    GROUP BY "postid"
    HAVING COUNT("id") = 1
)
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: Among the comments with scores between 5 to 10, what is the percentage of the users with 0 up votes?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.UpVotes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.Id), 0) AS per FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u."upvotes" = 0 THEN c."userid" END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c."userid")
FROM "comments" c
JOIN "users" u ON c."userid" = u."id"
WHERE c."score" BETWEEN 5 AND 10
LIMIT 500
